anomalies.observed: R4, the main-bus I2C SCL pull-up to +3V3, carries value "2M2" (2.2 MΩ) in the netlist, and the SPICE deck models it as 2.2 Meg. Its own library part, PN and description, however, are 2.2 kΩ (PN RC0805FR-072K2L, "2.2 kOhms"). The companion SDA pull-up R3 is correctly "2k2" (2.2 kΩ).
anomalies.expected: R4 should be 2.2 kΩ, matching R3 and the specification's stated main-bus pull-up value.

evidence.quote: I2C pull-ups (R3, R4, 2.2 kΩ) for the main (non-isolated) I2C bus
(field (name "Description") "2.2 kOhms ±1% 0.125W, 1/8W Chip Resistor 0805 (2012 Metric) Moisture Resistant Thick Film")

anomalies.impact: The main I2C SCL line is pulled up by 2.2 MΩ instead of 2.2 kΩ (~1000× too weak), giving SCL rise times of hundreds of microseconds. The main bus (EZO-RTD and the primary sides of the U3/U4 ADM3260 isolators that bridge to the pH/EC EZOs) will not meet I2C timing, so pH/EC/RTD communication will be unreliable or fail entirely.

parsed.summary: The design files contain one clear deviation: the main I2C SCL pull-up R4 is specified as 2.2 MΩ (value "2M2", modeled as 2.2Meg) instead of the 2.2 kΩ required by the spec and by its own part number/description and by its SDA counterpart R3, which would cripple the main I2C bus.
